name: Undying Bird of Paradise
descriptionTemplate: Dispel self {Blighten} state, restore [Heal:Arg1] HP and gain 1 Arithmetica. Upon receiving lethal DMG in this battle, revive and restore [Arg2]% HP. Can only be triggered once per battle.
lore:
In the vast ocean, a lone ship sways with the waves.
They pray, beg, and plead, hoping the White Holy Maiden will guide them away from the sea and back to their homeland.
On the central mast, a girl in a white dress looks up and sees a white bird.
"Give me the helm, and I will lead you home."

patch.descriptionTemplate: Dispels own {Blighten} state, restores [Heal:Arg1] HP and gains 1 Arithmetica. Revives upon receiving lethal DMG during this battle, restores [Arg2]% HP and grants all Awakeners [Energy:Arg4] Aliemus. This revive Effect can only be triggered again after 6 turns.
